messages:
deploy-bot: Cut and created release tag `v3.2.0-rc1` on commit `a7f4b2c` and staged promotion plan. Changelog summary: added request-level batching improvements, KV cache hotfix, minor model tokenizer tweak. Changelog: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v3.2.0-rc1. Canary window: EU start 09:15 UTC, staged ramp to global by ~10:15 UTC. Rollout window 2h. Requesting pins for reserved capacity groups and a brief autoscale hold for first 30m. @sre-ops :rocket:

nina: Are we pinning this for Dedicated customers or only hosted? Need to tell account owners if Dedicated will see the model bump.

aj: Can we hold autoscaling to prevent noisy scaling during the first 30m? Last release we saw GC spikes when burst backed in.

sre-ops: I'll handle pinning for reserved groups. Which groups to pin? confirm names and I'll apply KMS tags.

deploy-bot: Pinning targets requested: `reserved-prod-ml-1`, `reserved-prod-ml-2`. Starting pin operation now. Logs: https://deploy.logs/2134040900. Will update when completed.

pm-evan: @nina @aj I'll add a short note to the release blurb about the autoscale hold. Can we also add a rollback gate at 10:30 UTC (30m into ramp) for quick decision?

carla: Rollback gate acknowledged. Proposed rollback condition: >2% increase in 5xxs sustained for 5m OR median tail latency +30% for 10m. Who will own the rollback action?

aj: I'll be oncall for the rollout window and can run the rollback. Ping me and @oncall if triggers hit.

deploy-bot: Pin ops complete: `reserved-prod-ml-1`, `reserved-prod-ml-2` pinned to `v3.2.0`. Canary configured at 5% for EU. Monitoring hooks enabled (latency, 5xx, error-rate). :white_check_mark:

nina: Thanks. Also small doc update: note expected model size increase ~5% for embeddings. I'll push a short note to docs.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:15 UTC. Health checks green. Will post interim status at +15m and +30m.

carla: If anything spikes I'll post an ops blurb to #incidents and coordinate rollback with @aj.

aj: Watching metrics now. Ping me on pagerduty or here for immediate action.

deploy-bot: Canary passed checks at 09:30 UTC (no regressions observed). Starting staged ramp to 25% then to 100% over next 45m. ETA full rollout ~10:12 UTC.

carla: Noted, I'll stand by.

aj: All good on my side so far. Latency stable.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed at 10:12 UTC. Promoted tag `v3.2.0` to stable. Final changelog and release notes published: https://redwood.ai/releases/v3.2.0. Closing thread — thanks everyone :tada:
